items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: working with Carol Dixon and Jack Carter... I was the piano player myself. Jack Carter... Drums.

ctx.x: 1923. Oh, did you go to Europe in 23? Uh-huh. Come right back off the road and working with Carol Dixon and Jack Carter, says, boy, let's go to China. I said, man, no, I've just come back off of that thing. I don't want to move, you know. So he left. I was working at the Plantation with King Oliver. Something happened that got me disgusted and Jack's wife come in there and she says, anything you want me to tell Jack, I'm going to Shanghai. We're leaving in the morning, you know. I said, well, ask him if that…
